- `auth:diputados` -> `auth:camara-de-diputados` (applied): Same body (Cámara de Diputados); dossier contributor minted a second id.
- `person:luis-pinanez` -> `person:luis-lionel-pinanez` (applied): Same prosecutor: record p1 "Luis Lionel Piñanez" (stamp "Abg. Luis L. Piñanez"); chrono label "Luis Piñánez". Canonical label per the record: Luis Lionel Piñanez.
- `org:credicentro` -> `org:ueno-holding` (applied): Credicentro was renamed ueno Holding in 2022 (chrono:event:0005); press and chrono already carry "Credicentro" as an alias of org:ueno-holding. Keep "Credicentro" as alias and as the name valid before 2022.
- `org:muv` -> `org:click-sa-muv` (applied): Rey's "MUV" is the brand of Click S.A. (press entity "Click S.A. (MUV)").
- `org:wepa` -> `org:redisa` (applied): Press and Solventa give Wepa as the brand of Red Digital S.A. (REDISA); Rey says WEPA ran the former Visión Banco branches. Caveat: ABC (12 Oct) pairs the brands the other way round ("Redipro (Wepa)"); medium confidence.
- `org:bankitti` -> `org:itti` (applied): "Bankitti" is ITTI's banking-software product/brand (press:fact:0218 files Bankitti metrics under org:itti); the record says L. F. Ríos is an "employee" at Bankitti. Medium confidence; if kept separate, add a brand_of link.
